descriptionChirho: A proper noun referring to Zadok (Hebrew tsadoq, 'righteous'), primarily the high priest who served under David and Solomon and whose line became the dominant priestly dynasty; also borne by several other individuals in the OT (Neh 3:4,29; 10:21; 13:13; 1 Chr 6:12; 2 Kgs 15:33). All three clusters are syntactic variants of the same name: bare/conjunctive/prepositional 'Zadok/Tsadoq/and Zadok' (S129491), dative 'to Zadok/for Zadok' (S129493), and a further prepositional variant 'for Tsadok' (S129496). Multilingual evidence is uniform: 'सादोक' (hin), 'صَادُوقَ/صادوق' (arb), '사독' (kor), 'Sadoki' (swa), 'Tsadoq/Sadoc' (spa). Prepositional prefixes (le-, bet-, etc.) create no semantic distinction.
